Auditor_Jones: Hi team — for the SOC 2 walkthrough we need a full chain-of-custody package for the audit window 2025-12-01 -> 2025-12-07. Specifically: (A) KMS/HSM activity for alias/redwood-audit-key during that window, (B) the S3 evidence export(s) created for export job id export-20251203-42, including presigned links and checksums, and (C) exact reproducible steps we can run to recreate the export (commands, roles, key IDs). Please include timestamps and which engineer performed each step.

lisa (compliance): copying in details — this maps to CC6 and CC7 evidence. We also need to show any redaction steps applied before export (PII rules).

anita (sec): We can produce this. High-level: we have an audit-export pipeline that snapshots logs, requests an envelope key from KMS, wraps it with the HSM, and uploads the encrypted tarball to s3://redwood-audit-exports/. For the job id you mentioned the object key is export-20251203-42.tar.gz.enc. Below are the reproducible steps (run by a service principal with AuditExport role).

anita (sec): ```bash
# locate job metadata
aws dynamodb get-item --table audit-export-jobs --key '{"job_id":{"S":"export-20251203-42"}}' --region us-west-2
# download object
aws s3api get-object --bucket redwood-audit-exports --key export-20251203-42.tar.gz.enc /tmp/export-20251203-42.tar.gz.enc
# describe KMS key used for envelope (alias shown in metadata)
aws kms describe-key --key-id alias/redwood-audit-key --region us-west-2
# verify sha256 checksum provided in metadata
sha256sum /tmp/export-20251203-42.tar.gz.enc
```

mike (eng-sre): HSM wrap/unwrap and operator actions are logged in our internal EFK cluster under index `hsm-control-plane-*`. Example Kibana query to pull wrap events for the key during the window: `event.type: "hsm-wrap" AND key_alias: "alias/redwood-audit-key" AND @timestamp:[2025-12-01T00:00:00 TO 2025-12-07T23:59:59]`

mike (eng-sre): Sample command to export the raw HSM audit snippet (filtered to job id) from our infra tooling:```bash
infra-logs fetch --index hsm-control-plane --filter 'job_id:export-20251203-42' --start 2025-12-01T00:00:00 --end 2025-12-07T23:59:59 > /tmp/hsm-wrap-export-20251203-42.jsonl
```

sec-oncall-bot: Export job export-20251203-42: completed; uploader=svc-audit, object=export-20251203-42.tar.gz.enc, size=1.2GB, checksum=sha256:3a7f2d...c9b1 (stored in metadata).

lisa (compliance): For the evidence packet we will include: CSV chain_of_custody.csv with columns [file_key, exported_by, export_ts, checksum_sha256, kms_key_alias, hsm_wrap_event_id, redaction_applied]. Example row for this job:```
export-20251203-42.tar.gz.enc,svc-audit,2025-12-03T19:14:22Z,3a7f2d...c9b1,alias/redwood-audit-key,hsm-wrap-77821,true
```

Auditor_Jones: Can you provide a presigned link and the sha256 verified by an engineer? Also need confirmation that the HSM wrap event includes operator session id and that the wrap private key never leaves the HSM.

anita (sec): Presigned link (expires 7 days): https://s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/redwood-audit-exports/export-20251203-42.tar.gz.enc?X-Amz-Expires=604800 (link placeholder). SHA256 we calculated on the worker that uploaded: 3a7f2d5f9b8c2e1a6f4d2b0c9b1e7f6a0c3d2b1e9a8f7c6d5b4a3c2d1e0f9a8

anita (sec): HSM policy: wrap/unwrap operations emit events with operator principal, operator session id, and HSM operation id; private key material is KMS-managed and never exported — we can include a signed statement from the HSM vendor + our ops that confirms this for the export window. The raw event id for the wrap is `hsm-wrap-77821` and includes session_id `sess-9f3b`.

mike (eng-sre): Note on redaction: the export pipeline runs a redaction step before packaging. The redaction rule set v1.3 was applied to this job (see /infra/configs/audit-redaction-v1.3.yml). If auditor wants unredacted for internal review under an NDA we can provide a controlled access workflow — need approval from legal.

lisa (compliance): Timeline: we will assemble the CSV chain_of_custody, the HSM event extract, the KMS describe-key output, and the presigned object in a single evidence packet and upload to the auditor bucket with separate access controls. ETA 48 hours from now.

Auditor_Jones: Ok — please include a short reproduction checklist so we can verify independently. Also please include the exact IAM role ARN used by the export service.

anita (sec): Repro checklist (short):
1) Assume role `arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/AuditExportRole`
2) Run `aws dynamodb get-item --table audit-export-jobs --key '{"job_id":{"S":"export-20251203-42"}}'` to fetch metadata (look for kms_key and object_key fields)
3) Run `aws s3api get-object --bucket redwood-audit-exports --key <object_key> /tmp/object`
4) Run `sha256sum /tmp/object` and compare to provided checksum
5) Pull HSM wrap events via `infra-logs fetch --index hsm-control-plane --filter 'job_id:export-20251203-42'` and verify operator session id and event id.

mike (eng-sre): Echoing that the role is `arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/AuditExportRole` and the service principal is `svc-audit@redwood-internal` (service account).

Auditor_Jones: Thanks — that looks good. We'll wait for the evidence packet and CSV. If legal NDA is needed for unredacted logs I'll flag it.

lisa (compliance): Acknowledged — starting the package build now. Will post S3 path and checksum when ready (within 48h). :thumbsup:

Auditor_Jones: Received, appreciated.
